entities.name: Kambal
entities.description: A corrupt human who oversaw the distribution of aether on Avishkar and later became mayor of Prosperity on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Plane where Kambal oversaw aether distribution.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane where Kambal became mayor of Prosperity.

entities.name: Prosperity
entities.description: City on Thunder Junction of which Kambal is the corrupt mayor.

entities.name: Bomat
entities.description: City on Avishkar that Kambal oversaw from his estate.

entities.name: Gonti's Night Market
entities.description: A market surrounded by docks, warehouses and abandoned buildings below Kambal's estate.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: An aetherborn crime lord entertained at Kambal's estate.

entities.name: Enlightened Keepers
entities.description: The consuls of whom Kambal was one.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: Rebels whose revolt led to Kambal's replacement.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Replaced Kambal after the revolt of the Renegades.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: Ally of Kambal in kidnapping inventors from the Inventors' Fair.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Ally of Kambal in kidnapping inventors from the Inventors' Fair.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: Group Kambal joined on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A passage between planes through which Kambal reached Thunder Junction.

events.summary: Kambal oversees Bomat from his estate and supervises aether distribution as Consul of Allocation, while keeping black market ties.
events.quote: As the Consul of Allocation , he supervised the distribution of aether throughout the city.

events.summary: Kambal allies with Baral and Tezzeret and kidnaps the best inventors from the Inventors' Fair.
events.quote: He was allied with Baral and Tezzeret when he kidnapped the best inventors from the Inventors' Fair .

events.summary: After the revolt of the Renegades, Kambal is replaced by Pia Nalaar.
events.quote: After the revolt of the Renegades , Kambal was replaced by Pia Nalaar .

events.summary: Kambal reaches Thunder Junction through an Omenpath, joins the Sterling Company and becomes corrupt mayor of Prosperity.
events.quote: Kambal found his way onto Thunder Junction through an Omenpath , joining the Sterling Company and becoming the corrupt mayor of Prosperity .
